Class Vt100TokenWindow.Book

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.Vt100TokenWindow.Book
Enclosing class:
Vt100TokenWindow
public static final class Vt100TokenWindow.Book extends Object
The Book type holds the Roux lines for this window, one chat per user. The name Roux means the chat the lines belong to. The missing user is an empty chat. The later put(String, Vt100TokenWindow.Line[]) replaces the whole chat for that user.

  • Method Details

    • put

      public void put(String user, Vt100TokenWindow.Line[] rows)
      The put method stores one user's chat. The method stores a null user under an empty name. The method stores a null row array as an empty array. The stored array is a new array. The Vt100TokenWindow.Line objects in that array are the same objects that were passed in. The user who is already present has that chat replaced. The new user is appended.
      Parameters:
      user - The Roux user. The value may be null.
      rows - The messages for that user. The null array is an empty chat.

    • tally

      public Vt100TokenWindow.Tally tally(String user)
      The tally method sums one user's chat. The method looks up a null user under an empty name. The user with no stored chat returns the tally of a null line array. The empty tally has 0 used tokens. The empty tally has 0 characters. The empty tally has 0 messages.
      Parameters:
      user - The Roux user. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the sum for that chat.

    • index

      private int index(String key)
      The index method finds the stored name that equals the key. The method returns the matching index. The method returns -1 when no name matches.
      Parameters:
      key - The user name to find. The caller does not pass null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the index, or -1.
